scope: Walking-pose production experiments only. No walking provider, lab selection or gameplay appearance enabled. All returned pixels preserved; no individual fitting/normalization, clipping repairs or relaxed bounds.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One precisely registered hair-only layer for a hand-painted game walk pose.
Input1 is the EXACT bald resident geometry target (walking pose 0), on a1254-square transparent canvas. Input2 is the accepted short brown curly hair STYLE/SHAPE reference from a DIFFERENT pose; its old position is NOT this target's position.
Paint the SAME hairstyle onto input1's actual scalp, following its crown, forehead hairline and visible ear. Preserve short rounded volume, broad curl cluster arrangement, painted edge treatment and upper-left light of input2. Do not invent another wig. The walking head is farther RIGHT than the style reference.
Return ONLY added hair, with all body, head, face, skin, ears, eyebrows and clothing fully transparent. Keep exact1254x1254 canvas and target coordinates. Entire hair must remain in outer x,y,width,height rectangle [602.5,68.6,333.1,293.9], following actual scalp rather than filling rectangle. Crown begins above the bald crown near y115; forehead/eyes and visible ear remain open. Stop behind/above the ear near y290; NO dangling curl or U-loop beneath the ear, NO skin backing.
Most canvas must be empty transparent space. No body with hair, centered standalone wig, labels, guides, shadows, ground, background, crop, resizing or recentering. It will be composited over input1 as a whole frame with no independent fitting. Warm illustrated painted curls readable at48-pixel resident size.
records.findings: Direct static fit is close. Matching dimensions and unchanged bounds gate pass. Full walking-set and temporal/style approval remain open.
